summary: Non-regression frontend testing of the internal refactor that (a) removed orphan src/lib/database.types.ts and (b) moved supabase.rpc('touch_member') from (app)/layout.tsx into a new touchMember(tenantId) function in src/lib/data/access.ts. All 5 requested scenarios PASSED with no regressions. (1) /login loads HTTP 200 with visible email + password inputs and 'Entrar' submit; (2) accessing / while logged out redirects to /login (middleware still works); (3) login with teste@exemplo.com / 123456 authenticates and lands on / rendering the app shell — [data-testid=home-greeting]='Olá! Bem-vindo(a) à Empresa Teste LTDA' and [data-testid=sidebar-nav] present, no white screen / 500 / Next.js error dialog. This confirms the layout.tsx path that awaits touchMember(activeId) from @/lib/data/access executes successfully; (4) navigating to /pessoas renders the members table — [data-testid=member-row-teste@exemplo.com] and [data-testid=invite-open-button] present, no error; (5) hard reload (F5) on / re-executes the layout (and therefore touchMember) — home-greeting and sidebar-nav still render with identical greeting text. No console errors, no server-side crash, no pageerror events. Only benign console warnings observed (font preload timing).
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: touchMember(tenantId) is a thin wrapper over supabase.rpc('touch_member', { p_tenant: tenantId }) in src/lib/data/access.ts; layout.tsx correctly awaits it inside try/catch so RPC failures remain non-critical, preserving prior behaviour.

Import in layout.tsx `import { getMyPermissions, touchMember } from '@/lib/data/access'` is correct and there are no remaining references to database.types.ts (verified indirectly — no build error on any tested route).
touchMember returns void and swallows the supabase error object; if you ever want observability, consider logging error?.message inside the wrapper (non-blocking suggestion, not a regression).
seed_data_creation: None. Invite/grant flows were NOT exercised in this iteration (per request: non-destructive regression only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor validated. next.config.mjs still contains the serverActions.allowedOrigins fix from iteration_2 (needed for invite/grant/revoke/status server actions through the preview ingress). Preview URL used: https://company-invite.preview.emergentagent.com. The Next dev indicator (`nextjs-portal` element) is always present in DOM — do not treat it as an error; check for `[data-nextjs-dialog-overlay]` or actual `.error` text instead.
rca of the issue: No issue found; refactor is a true non-regression.
